newsitem.title: FRANCE: Generale des Eaux sells unit to Bercy.
newsitem.headline: Generale des Eaux sells unit to Bercy.

text.p: French conglomerate Generale des Eaux sold to Bercy Management its 47.7 percent stake in restaurant holding company Generale de Restauration, Bercy and Generale des Eaux said on Monday.
Before selling its stake to Bercy, Generale des Eaux had repurchased an 11.7 stake in Generale de Restauration from Compass Plc. Compass bought the stake in December 1996.
An industry source said the sale was carried out based on a valuation of Generale de Restauration of 2.1 billion francs.
At the same time, Generale des Eaux also sold Bercy the remaining 22 percent it held in food distributor Elitair.
